commonApartmentPatterns: rectangular massing and repeated floor bands
metal grille treatment on some balconies
stronger colour zones on some facades
rooftop/parapet features should be modelled only when visible or sourced
A Commons photo has a camera viewpoint coordinate (23.717992, 90.404548) but this coordinate must not be mistaken for the centroid of every building visible in the image.

Some open-licensed reference images are high resolution (e.g. Banani Model Town facade/house views and Azimpur apartment photo); inspect the full-resolution original before estimating bays or roof elements.
contemporaryPatterns: Architect-reported 8–9 storey Bashundhara projects can be used to formulate test variants for floor repetition, north/south balconies, lobby/parking ground floors, large windows and shared roof amenities; treat promotional descriptions as design intent rather than survey truth.
heritagePatterns: Beauty Boarding and Rose Garden illustrate distinct courtyard/heritage cases: arched veranda/courtyard composition versus formal mansion-and-garden composition. Keep them as separate style families.
derivedArchitectureNotes.modelConfidenceRule: A single image supports facade-level guesses only. GPS proximity does not prove a building match. Multi-view reconstruction requires adequate overlapping views of the same building, varied useful camera angles and review; three images or positions alone are not sufficient evidence.
typologyCautions: 1970s–1980s duplex descriptions are historical typology evidence, not a claim that all current houses in the named neighbourhoods share these features.
Commercial real-estate project pages and rendered visuals are not open-licensed by default; keep them research-only unless permissions are confirmed.
Open licences differ: CC BY 2.0 requires attribution; CC BY-SA files additionally require compatible ShareAlike distribution for adaptations. Preserve each file's own licence and source.
